| description = King Xorbb is an elusive monster in Beholder's Maze, and a [[Wizard]], unlike most of his subjects. He has two spawn points at (672, -207) and (867, -920) with a 6:40 minute respawn and the following spawn table of placeholders. An evil eye that spawns on the (672, -207) location is much lower level, does not summon a pet, and typically dies in a single hit.  There is also a normal evil eye that will roam (normal hps and can have pet) that can spawn at (867, -920) and is also a placeholder. 

* [[a muddite minor]]
* [[a muddite elder]]
* [[a chasm minotaur]]
* [[an evil eye]] (one is without a pet)
* [[Brahhm]]
* [[King Xorbb]]

'''None of the following are placeholders for [[King Xorbb]].'''

* [[A chasm minotaur]] which spawns near (110, 15) with a reduced 4min-30sec respawn
* Three other roaming [[an evil eye]]s
* Three static spawns in the temple area (#1 on the map) including [[Lord Syrkl]], [[Lord Soptyvr]], and [[Lord Sviir]].

Notes from Pokesan and Buellen in this [http://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=271251 forum thread]

'''Strategy'''

Go to a spawn point. Wait until one of the PH mobs listed above ''stops'' at that exact spot.  Kill it and wait 6:40 to see if anything spawns at that spot to confirm it was a PH.  Alternatively kill every roamer that comes close to the spawn point and wait to see what spawns directly at the spawn point.  Once you have the timer set for one spawn point, repeat for the other.  

'''Note:''' The spawn chance is around 0.4%-0.6% - so, roughly two hundred pops, you might see one King. A 10-12 hour session killing <s>a single PH should</s> both spawn spots to statistically see the King once.
